title: Social Intelligence Data Infrastructure: Structuring the Present and Navigating the Future

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the linguistic diversity across a constructed library of 480 social intelligence NLP datasets to identify representation disparities, specifically highlighting the dominant overrepresentation of English data.

Evaluating the metadata of 480 NLP datasets to quantify the lack of specific cultural representation, alongside zero-shot evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on the CulturalNLI dataset to assess their performance deficits in making culturally aware natural language inferences.
